column3: a slick founder pitching an invented digital token to investors in a glass penthouse, the token shown only as a plain smooth gold disc with no marks at all, investors seen from behind
a small shop suddenly mobbed by excited customers holding up phones whose screens are plain glowing rectangles, confetti in the air, no icons or symbols anywhere
an invented speculative digital token: a crowd on a neon-lit street market trading glowing blank discs, the discs completely smooth with no marks or symbols, sold in a frenzy

an index fund that owns a slice of every company on the exchange: a calm panorama of many industries side by side (farms, factories, ports, offices, shops), all buildings plain with no emblems or symbols on them
